title: Automated Engineering Newsletter
short_desc: An automated weekly newsletter that gathers engineering news and sends it to 190+ colleagues. Each reader gets only the topics they signed up for.
problem: Engineering news had to reach many colleagues, but not everyone wanted every topic.
built: Colleagues submit news in a simple app, and readers pick their topics in another. Every week an automated flow sorts the news into three topic streams, builds a formatted email and sends it out.
result: Sent every week to 190+ colleagues, each with their own topics.
tech_notes: Two Power Apps: one for submitting news and one where readers manage their topics. A scheduled Power Automate flow runs weekly. It sorts the news into three topic streams, builds an HTML email from nested tables and sends it only to current subscribers.
